Title: Generally Available: Visualize New Azure Resource Manager Metrics through Azure Monitor

Body.Content:
We are announcing that Azure Resource Manager now offers enhanced integration with Azure Monitor Metrics for your subscriptions! You can now have deeper visibility and more granular monitoring capabilities for your Resource Manager operations.

You can access traffic, latency, and throttling insights by choosing the Azure Resource Manager metric in Azure Monitor. You can use REST APIs, SDKs, or explore them directly in the Azure Portal. There's no opt-in or sign-up process to access control plane metrics.

New Dimensions Available:
You can now analyze and filter your metrics using the following new dimensions:
  • Operation type: By high customer demand, you can now distinguish between different operation categories (read, write, delete)!
  • ARM request region: Identify where requests originate and monitor regional trends.
  • HTTP method: Break down metrics by request type (GET, POST, etc.).
  • HTTP status code: Track specific response codes for better troubleshooting.
  • HTTP status code class: Group responses by class (2xx, 4xx, 5xx) for high-level insights.
  • Resource type: Filter metrics by the type of Azure resource.
  • RP namespace: Analyze metrics by resource provider namespace.
Learn more.

These new dimensions empower you to create more targeted alerts, dashboards, and reports, helping you optimize performance and quickly identify issues across your Azure environment. Let us know in the comments what other metrics you want to see!
